params.name: url
params.description: The source URL for the image to transcode.  Note, if this URL requires a token such as `X-Plex-Token`, it should be given as a query parameter to this url.

params.name: format
params.description: The output format for the image; defaults to jpg

params.name: width
params.description: The desired width of the output image

params.name: height
params.description: The desired height of the output image

params.name: quality
params.description: The desired quality of the output.  -1 means the highest quality.  Defaults to -1

params.name: background
params.description: The background color to apply before painting the image.  Only really applicable if image has transparency.  Defaults to none

params.name: upscale
params.description: Indicates if image should be upscaled to the desired width/height.  Defaults to false

params.name: minSize
params.description: Indicates if image should be scaled to fit the smaller dimension.  By default (false) the image is scaled to fit within the width/height specified but if this parameter is true, it will allow overflowing one dimension to fit the other.  Essentially it is making the width/height minimum sizes of the image or sizing the image to fill the entire width/height even if it overflows one dimension.

params.name: rotate
params.description: Obey the rotation values specified in EXIF data.  Defaults to true.

params.name: blur
params.description: Apply a blur to the image, Defaults to 0 (none)

params.name: saturation
params.description: Scale the image saturation by the specified percentage.  Defaults to 100

params.name: opacity
params.description: Render the image at the specified opacity percentage.  Defaults to 100

params.name: chromaSubsampling
params.description:
Use the specified chroma subsambling.
  - 0: 411
  - 1: 420
  - 2: 422
  - 3: 444
Defaults to 3 (444)

params.name: blendColor
params.description: The color to blend with the image.  Defaults to none

items.docs: Transcode an image, possibly changing format or size

info.name: Make a decision on media playback

params.name: transcodeType
params.description: Type of transcode media

params.name: transcodeSessionId
params.description: Transcode session UUID

params.name: advancedSubtitles
params.description: Indicates how  incompatible advanced subtitles (such as ass/ssa) should be included: * 'burn' - Burn incompatible advanced text subtitles into the video stream * 'text' - Transcode incompatible advanced text subtitles to a compatible text format, even if some markup is lost

params.name: audioBoost
params.description: Percentage of original audio loudness to use when transcoding (100 is equivalent to original volume, 50 is half, 200 is double, etc)

params.name: audioChannelCount
params.description: Target video number of audio channels.

params.name: autoAdjustQuality
params.description: Indicates the client supports ABR.

params.name: autoAdjustSubtitle
params.description: Indicates if the server should adjust subtitles based on Voice Activity Data.

params.name: directPlay
params.description: Indicates the client supports direct playing the indicated content.

params.name: directStream
params.description: Indicates the client supports direct streaming the video of the indicated content.

params.name: directStreamAudio
params.description: Indicates the client supports direct streaming the audio of the indicated content.

params.name: disableResolutionRotation
params.description: Indicates if resolution should be adjusted for orientation.

params.name: hasMDE
params.description: Ignore client profiles when determining if direct play is possible. Only has an effect when directPlay=1 and both mediaIndex and partIndex are specified and neither are -1

params.name: location
params.description: Network type of the client, can be used to help determine target bitrate.

params.name: mediaBufferSize
params.description: Buffer size used in playback (in KB). Clients should specify a lower bound if not known exactly. This value could make the difference between transcoding and direct play on bandwidth constrained networks.

params.name: mediaIndex
params.description: Index of the media to transcode. -1 or not specified indicates let the server choose.

params.name: musicBitrate
params.description: Target bitrate for audio only files (in kbps, used to transcode).

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset from the start of the media (in seconds).

params.name: partIndex
params.description: Index of the part to transcode. -1 or not specified indicates the server should join parts together in a transcode

params.name: path
params.description: Internal PMS path of the media to transcode.

params.name: peakBitrate
params.description: Maximum bitrate (in kbps) to use in ABR.

params.name: photoResolution
params.description: Target photo resolution.

params.name: protocol
params.description: Indicates the network streaming protocol to be used for the transcode session: * 'http' - include the file in the http response such as MKV streaming * 'hls' - hls stream (RFC 8216) * 'dash' - dash stream (ISO/IEC 23009-1:2022)

params.name: secondsPerSegment
params.description: Number of seconds to include in each transcoded segment

params.name: subtitleSize
params.description: Percentage of original subtitle size to use when burning subtitles (100 is equivalent to original size, 50 is half, ect)

params.name: subtitles
params.description: Indicates how subtitles should be included: * 'auto' - Compute the appropriate subtitle setting automatically * 'burn' - Burn the selected subtitle; auto if no selected subtitle * 'none' - Ignore all subtitle streams * 'sidecar' - The selected subtitle should be provided as a sidecar * 'embedded' - The selected subtitle should be provided as an embedded stream * 'segmented' - The selected subtitle should be provided as a segmented stream

params.name: videoBitrate
params.description: Target video bitrate (in kbps).

params.name: videoQuality
params.description: Target photo quality.

params.name: videoResolution
params.description: Target maximum video resolution.
